channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: New federal pay plan could trigger retirement wave among critical workers
item.description: Workers warn that the plan, which denies raises to most federal roles, may lead to a retention crisis as critical employees retire.

item.title: MacKenzie Scott's latest donation pushes HBCU giving past $1 billion
item.description: The billionaire philanthropist continues her streak of large, unrestricted gifts to historically Black colleges and universities.

item.title: NYC schools ban AI for elementary and middle school students
item.description: The nation's largest school system has imposed a one-year moratorium on AI use in its elementary and middle schools.

item.title: Tech giants invest heavily in data centers while benefiting from tax breaks, causing revenue shortfalls in some states
item.description: Thirty-six states offer tax incentives for data center development, reducing equipment costs for companies.
